definitions.explanation: A smaller dish that accompanies the main dish in a meal. Typically vegetables or lighter preparations that complement the main course.

examples.japanese: {副菜|ふくさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}りました→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made simmered vegetables as a side dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{副菜|ふくさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Side dishes are important for a balanced meal.

examples.japanese: {副菜|ふくさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二|に}{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧ (secondary) + {菜|さい} (dish).

CULTURAL NOTE:
Nutrition guides and school lunches describe a Japanese meal as ⟦{主食|しゅしょく}→主食：11408_shushoku⟧ (rice or bread), ⟦{主菜|しゅさい}→主菜：04995_shusai⟧ (the main protein dish), {副菜|ふくさい} (vegetable dishes) and ⟦{汁物|しるもの}→汁物：06231_shirumono⟧ (soup). The {副菜|ふくさい} supply the vegetables, seaweed and mushrooms.

TYPES:
- ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧: simmered dishes
- ⟦{和|あ}え{物|もの}→和え物：04979_aemono⟧: dressed dishes
- ⟦{酢|す}の{物|もの}→酢の物：04982_sunomono⟧: vinegared dishes
- ⟦お{浸|ひた}し→お浸し：10245_ohitashi⟧: boiled greens in dashi
- ⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧: salad

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おかず→おかず：08272_okazu⟧: any dish eaten with rice, main or side (everyday word)
- ⟦{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ→付け合わせ：08257_tsukeawase⟧: a garnish served on the same plate as the main dish
